entry.author: City Rail Link
entry.summary:
Tēnā koe,
We’re getting close now - and you can feel it. Behind the scenes things are stepping up a few notches as live emergency exercises get underway across the City Rail Link’s new stations and tunnels. Volunteer passengers are helping bring real-world scenarios to life, from onboard incidents to fire response, as rail teams and emergency services work side-by-side to make sure everything runs exactly as it should when it matters most. It’s all part of making sure that when we open later this year, your journey will be not just smooth and reliable, but a safe one too. We also go above ground with mana whenua artist Pāora Puru who takes us through the story behind the striking new Mercury Lane precinct at the doorstep of Karanga-a-Hape Station. A space rich in meaning, history and design.
Enjoy
